title: Vector storage and database design
subtitle: Choose guarantees as carefully as similarity algorithms.
goal: Choose the guarantees around the vectors
intro: A vector index supplies nearest candidates; the application still needs identity, scope, lifecycle, and authoritative data.
terms: A backend operation that is actually supported
case: Search private documents for one workspace.
The chosen backend must enforce the required scope during candidate selection.
Global top-k followed by filtering can miss the best authorized result.
